faq: No honest provider can. We improve clarity, remove friction and add tracking, which tends to help. We show you what changed and what the numbers say afterward.
Do I need much traffic to test changes?
For A/B tests, yes, ideally a few hundred visits per variant. With low traffic we skip tests and focus on proven fixes and tracking.
Will you change my brand design?
No. We work within your look, adjusting copy, layout order, buttons and forms. A bigger visual refresh would be our redesign service.
What tools do you use for tracking?
Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity or similar free tools set up in your own accounts. We tell you what each one collects so your cookie notice stays accurate.
